cohort: A1 Oregon — the 144 rows left after migration 1507
method: Fetched each cited Ballotpedia page and read ONLY the article body (#mw-content-text, script/style removed). Extracted DISTINCTIVE terms per row (multi-word capitalised phrases, hyphenated compounds, rare policy nouns), discarded any term appearing on >25% of the 68-page corpus, and discarded IDENTITY terms (county, town, chamber title, alma mater) which appear because it is that person's page and prove nothing about the claim. A row FAILS when none of its distinctive claim terms appear.
guards: Chrome is ~10% of article-body text; stripping RAW HTML instead pulls in the whole mega-menu and was the bug that invalidated the first attempt.
Article bodies under 3000 chars mean EXTRACTION failed, not that terms are absent. 5 pages hit this and are excluded from both the corpus and the verdicts (9 rows).

Ballotpedia rate-limits silently: parallel fetches return HTTP 202 with an empty body and r.ok is TRUE. All fetches here were serial at 1.2-1.4s and every page verified at status 200 with a substantial body.
consistency_check: The same templated "May 2023 Senate Republican walkout" sentence was applied to six people. "walkout" is present on exactly the three seated before 2023 (Thatcher, Hayden, Weber) and absent on the three seated in 2025 (Starr, Linthicum, Drazan). The test separates true from false instances of an identical claim.
